notes.title: Capyverse Joins "Four is a Party" - Celebrate Multiplayer Madness!
notes.content:

Capyverse Joins "Four is a Party" Multiplayer Celebration!

Capyverse got accepted into its first event! Get ready to team up and dive into the chaos as Capyverse takes part in the "Four is a Party" celebration! Join multiplayer gaming with thrilling co-op adventures. Whether you're battling through chaotic multiverses or strategizing with friends, it's time to unite and restore balance!  

What to Expect:
- Co-op Gameplay: Join forces with up to 4 players and take on the multiverse together.  
- New Challenges: Experience epic battles and unique characters in our fast-paced roguelike action.  
- Exciting Rewards: Participate during the event and unlock exclusive goodies.  

Don’t miss out—jump in with your friends and show the multiverse what Capyverse heroes are made of!  

Wishlist Capyverse on Steam now and join the party! 🌟

notes.title: DEMO is out! Join Capy’s multiverse adventure—play today! 🎃
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931283/a9b7c6d0803f5ac5e51f44f099ac33c0d41978d2.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931283/e190b96bd4398a1f80ab718d0cf7039606f59296.png

1. Welcome to the Halloween-themed demo of Capyverse Odyssey! Get ready to navigate spooky multiverses, fight enemies, and face the ultimate clown boss. Join forces with your first ally, the Seagull Squadron, and unleash chaos with special abilities and powerful weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931283/088dfa0ead246bd8d82c27cb6820911c59c26f54.jpg

2. Game Modes
Solo Adventure: Take on eerie multiverses alone.
Multiplayer: Team up with up to 3 friends and tackle enemies together (Coming Soon)

3. Levels

 Carnival of Chaos: A twisted circus filled with creepy clowns and deadly attractions.
 Forgotten Graveyard: Battle through haunted tombstones and restless spirits in an eerie cemetery.
 Neon Nights: A neon-lit cityscape full of sinister surprises and lurking foes.
 Ribcage Isle: An island littered with the bones of giant creatures, including dinosaur ribs.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931283/e748c855d06917570bd9d79bbfa06e20ee98953d.jpg

4. Final Boss
Clown Boss: At the end of the journey, face the terrifying clown boss in a chaotic battle of wits and strength.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931283/7ebd4eabf14c10a9220c1445e99f34d4fac7196f.jpg

5. Capy Ally: Seagull Squadron
Your first ally is the mighty Seagull Squadron, a group of fearless aerial fighters:

 Missile Special Ability: Launch homing missiles that strike enemies from above.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931283/3187853c1cf2ecbd8cdc53a5e3b61a3cc01043df.jpg

6. Capy's Abilities

 Jetpack: Use Capy's jetpack for fast movement, allowing quick escapes and rapid positioning during intense battles.
 Coconut Bomb: Drop explosive coconut bombs to cause area damage.


7. Weapons

 Trumpet Shotgun: Dual-wield powerful trumpet shotguns to blast enemies at both close and long range.
 Dragon Rifle: A high-powered long-range weapon that delivers fiery blasts, perfect for taking down tougher enemies.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931283/7288fd74597f0055ce0ca88fb8c58492f3c27d55.jpg

8. Controls
Move: WASD
Shoot Weapon: Left click
Coconut Bomb: Right click
Special Ally Attack: Q
Switch Weapon: Scroll / 1 and 2
Jetpack: Shift for fast movement

9. Objective
Survive the four spooky levels, defeat hordes of enemies, and conquer the final clown boss to restore peace in the first multiverse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931283/12440e1495781aabc076019f18eb15825caadf6b.jpg

10. Enemies
Each level is packed with unique Halloween-themed enemies, from zombie clowns to skeleton-neon minions, creepy crawlers, evil bumper cars, flying pumpkins and more. Watch out for their varied attacks and random patterns!

11. Power-ups

 Weapon Boost: Increases damage for all equipped weapons and abilities.
 Armor Upgrade: Provides additional protection by reducing incoming damage.
 Health Boost: Restores health.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931283/112fcbfa3c06728788c4030f22b8c89206dafc2b.jpg

12. Tips & Tricks

 Utilize Seagull Squadron: Their homing missile ability can be used to clear groups of enemies.
 Weapon Mastery: Switch between the trumpet shotguns to handle different enemy types and ranges.
 Jetpack Agility: Use the jetpack to move quickly and dodge enemy attacks or reposition in combat.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931283/b4b73af6e06215192108c7c9db9ee58d47387cd4.jpg

Thank you for playing the Capyverse Odyssey Halloween demo! Stay tuned for more updates and multiverse adventures!
